name: top-nav
title: Top Nav
description: Navigation bar for content sites (use app-shell for tool-style apps): brand on the left, NavigationMenu links on the right, in a wide (max-w-7xl) row. Below the md breakpoint the links move into a Sheet. Takes links, pathname and renderLink like app-shell; the most specific link containing pathname is marked current.
